entries.25198357d0c8f48d: A solution that develops and demonstrates the introduction of drone ports, “BEP Port,” from which drones take off and land. It also provides a tsunami evacuation announcement drone system, which works with J-Alert and automatically launches drones during tsunamis to deliver evacuation instructions, and operations have begun in Sendai City and Ichinomiya Town, Chiba Prefecture. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥252 million.
entries.28a50cfc72a32ce5: A single-segment business that provides solutions based on the software platform “Blue Earth Platform (BEP)”, which remotely controls and centrally manages multiple autonomous mobile robots (such as drones and AGVs). The solutions replace with drones and AGVs tasks previously performed by people, such as facility inspection and logistics, to improve efficiency, safety and labor savings. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,051 million, and the business consists of four solutions: Inspection, Port, Education and Next.

entries.92d0f10ebff5427e: A solution that uses drones and AGVs to inspect plant facilities, power transmission lines and other infrastructure. It provides indoor plant inspection “BEP Inspection,” which uses the spherical guard drone “ELIOS”; power transmission line inspection “BEP Line,” developed jointly with the Tokyo Electric Power Company Group; and automated patrol inspection using AGVs, “BEP Surveillance.” Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥576 million.

Under “BEP Basic,” basic education run in cooperation with the General Incorporated Association Japan UAS Industrial Promotion Council (JUIDA), it provides operation outsourcing for drone schools, a pilot management system, and the flight log service “BLUE SKY.” It also offers advanced education and the flight support mapping service “SORAPASS.” Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥203 million.
